Fenghuang HSR station.notes: Arrive ~16:00; ~10 km to the old town.

Check in at Jinshuian.notes: Check in on the Huilongge / lower-river stretch.

East Gate Tower.notes: Start the daylight orientation walk here.

Hong Bridge.notes: Along the river to the covered Hongqiao bridge.

Jumping stones.notes: Cross near North Gate early, before crowds and harsh midday light.

Dinner.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Bar street.notes: Loud riverside bar street by Hong Bridge — skip or embrace.

Station shuttle / taxi.notes: Into-town transfer options from the HSR station.

Wanming Pagoda.notes: Illuminated riverside pagoda — night photos from the north-bank lanes.

Snow Bridge (Xueqiao).notes: The best elevated night viewpoint, near the North Gate.

Sunrise / mist session.notes: Sunrise ~06:20 — the key payoff of the one-night stay.

Nanhua Bridge.notes: Dawn panoramic stilted-house sweep — the town is empty before 9–10am.

Shen Congwen Residence.notes: The author’s former home and Fenghuang’s key cultural stop; enter early.

Miao batik & silver lanes.notes: Batik (larǎn) and silverwork — a quick look if time allows.

Ginger candy stalls.notes: Watch it hand-pulled fresh — buy for the train.

Breakfast.notes: Hotel breakfast; open the hotel card for details.

Head to the station.notes: Leave with a buffer for the ~08:30 train (station ~10 km / 20 min out).
